data.title: US information-sector employment (BLS CES)
data.summary: US payroll employment in the information sector (NAICS 51 — software publishing, data processing and telecommunications, but not computer systems design) fell from a November 2022 peak of 3,115,000 to 2,780,000 in July 2026, a decline of 335,000 or 10.8%. An official establishment survey, not a layoff tracker.
data.citation: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Current Employment Statistics, series CES5000000001 (All employees, thousands, information, seasonally adjusted).
